sentences.text:
This is an application made under Section 438 Cr.P.C., seeking Page No.# 2/3 pre-arrest bail by the petitioner, namely, Ms. Sangjukta Borah, apprehending arrest in connection with Paltanbazar P.S.
Case No. 406/2023, registered under Sections 406/408/409/420 IPC.
Mr. Choudhury, the learned Senior counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has paid the entire amount for which the FIR has been lodged.

It is also submitted that the petitioner has appeared before the Investigating Police Officer as per direction of this Court and her statement has already been recorded after she was granted interim protection.
She has not misused the liberty granted to her; rather, she co-operate with the investigation of the case.
Therefore, the privilege of pre-arrest bail granted to the petitioner may be made absolute.

Mr. Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State submits that as the statement of petitioner has already been recorded by the investigating officer and as such, her custodial interrogation may not be required.
I have considered the submission made by the learned counsel for the parties and also perused the case diary.
It appears that the petitioner has not misused the liberty granted to her while availing interim protection and she has also paid the entire amount as alleged in the FIR.

Considering all,
this Court is of the view that the petitioner deserves to be granted the privilege of pre-arrest bail.
That being so, the petitioner is granted the privilege of pre- arrest bail.
Accordingly, the interim protection granted to the petitioner vide order dated 04.10.2023, is made absolute on the same terms and Page No.# 3/3 conditions, as reflected.
The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
Return the case diary.
